rows.normalization: AggregateError type assertion replaced by checked narrowing

rootCause: JSONL-only AdmissionFailureRecorder was paired with journal history. Factory-selected recorder, async commit boundaries and real positional-write admission now match the selected backend. Compensation diagnostics use the original old enqueue fault and native real media replacement rejection; native restore failure is observed without poisoning its reader. The media owner is registered before checkpoint capture. Paused publication uses a real owner supporting both replacement protocols and closes the held snapshot on release/rejection.
nativeProof: All 32 selected journal target cases independently compare complete public rows with reopened primary and mirror row trees. Existing 31 W11 native cases and two selected retry cases actually ran under both outer settings. Serialized digest bytes measure JSON row values, not physical native file size. Original 512/8192 scales, 440-row/8MiB limits and oversized-row case are unchanged.

intermediate.firstSelected: provider-initial-journal-h-a: 29 pass/one diagnostics failure; injected writer failure prevented later normal reads
intermediate.publication: provider-target-journal-h-b: two owner passes/one diagnostics failure; registering the owner after checkpoint capture did not put it into the captured transaction host
intermediate.finalTarget: provider-target-journal-h-c: three passes after registering before checkpoint capture
intermediate.lint: Initial max-lines-per-function failure fixed by extracting committed observation; no enforcement changes

census.acceptance: Only provider-final-journal-h-a is accepted after pending-final-journal-g-a; diagnostics, trap and outer-old are retained but unaccepted
